title: Decide whether to retrieve, then choose what to keep

exports.name: should_retrieve
exports.signature: should_retrieve(query: str, state: dict, threshold: float) -> bool
exports.description: Decide whether this step needs retrieval at all, given what the loop has already gathered.

exports.name: rerank_mmr
exports.signature: rerank_mmr(passages: list[dict], query: list[float], lam: float, k: int) -> list[dict]
exports.description: Select k passages one at a time, scoring each for query similarity against its similarity to what is already selected.

exports.name: select_k
exports.description: Choose how many of the scored passages to keep, within a token budget.

exports.name: run_loop
exports.signature: run_loop(query: str, retrieve, generate, max_steps: int) -> dict
exports.description: Run the loop to an answer using the supplied retrieve and generate callables, recording every retrieval decision it made.
